The smartphones, computers, communication devices, and AI services we use every day are visible on the surface as apps and devices. However, behind them are semiconductors and electronic components, and even further behind those are the materials that support their manufacturing.

Since JX Nippon Mining & Metals is a manufacturer, I think the work style varies significantly depending on the job function.

For technical roles, I expect the work to center on areas close to materials and factories, such as research and development, production technology, facility engineering, quality control, and manufacturing process improvement.

Also, as is typical for a manufacturer, I expect there to be many assignments at factories and business sites. If you have strong preferences regarding work locations, I think it is better to check in advance.
On the other hand, I believe that being able to learn about the front lines from a young age is a significant experience when working at a materials manufacturer.
